name: TBILLYIELD
description: TBILLYIELD returns the yield for a Treasury bill based on its price.
tldr: Calculates the yield for a Treasury bill.

basicExample.explanation: A 6-month T-bill priced at $97.50 per $100 face value has a yield of about 5.13%.

advancedExamples.title: Short-term T-bill
advancedExamples.explanation: Shorter maturities have lower yields for the same price discount.

howItWorks: TBILLYIELD calculates the yield using the formula (100 - pr) / pr * (360 / days to maturity). This is the standard T-bill yield calculation based on the bank discount method.

howToSteps.name: Calculate
howToSteps.text: Press Enter to get the result.

limitations: Maturity must be within one year of settlement.
Price must be less than 100 for a positive yield.

commonErrors.cause: Maturity is more than one year after settlement or price is invalid.
commonErrors.fix: Verify dates are within one year and price is less than 100.
Use DATE function or valid date serial numbers.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: TBILLYIELD works identically in Google Sheets.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Same syntax and behavior as Excel.

faq.question: What is the difference between TBILLYIELD and TBILLEQ?
faq.answer: TBILLYIELD returns the T-bill discount yield. TBILLEQ returns the bond-equivalent yield for comparison with bonds.

faq.question: When is TBILLYIELD used?
faq.answer: It is used for calculating the yield of US Treasury bills based on price.
